methods.description: Subtract the fixed loss for all periods from the original value.
Divide total loss by the stated number of periods.
Multiply fixed loss per period by number of periods.
Rearrange the straight-line formula for time; check whole-year thresholds.
Add the total depreciation to the salvage value.
Convert a percentage of purchase price into fixed dollar depreciation.
Compare total dollar depreciation with the original value as a percentage.
Read equal dollar changes and the value at a stated time from a straight line.
Subtract each fixed-dollar loss for its own time interval.
Convert elapsed years to months when the depreciation is monthly.
